slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-01 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H1: room types, floors, wards, rooms, beds. Five new tables, no ALTER of existing ones; idempotent, proven twice-run on a probe database.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-01 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H2: the patient registry — patients and the record-access log. Two new tables, no ALTER of existing ones; idempotent, proven twice-run on a probe database.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-01 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H3: accommodation — admissions and bed stays (two new tables) plus a nullable PhotoPath on HospitalPatients; one open admission per patient and one open stay per bed are filtered unique indexes. Idempotent, proven twice-run on a probe database.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-01 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H4: outpatient — departments, practitioners (schedule, licence, privileges) and appointments at a wall-clock minute; one live appointment per doctor per slot is a filtered unique index. Three new tables; idempotent, proven twice-run on a probe database.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-01 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H5: the consultation — encounters (SOAP, vitals, follow-up), their diagnoses and prescription lines, and the diagnosis code catalogue. One encounter per appointment; a signed one records when. Four new tables; idempotent, proven twice-run on a probe database.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-02 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H6: billing and the cashier — billing settings (tax, GL account map), the service catalogue, consultation orders, bills and lines, cashier shifts and payments; postings go through the accounting journal engine. Seven new tables plus a nullable ConsultationServiceId on HospitalPractitioners; idempotent, proven twice-run on a probe database.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-02 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H7: price lists — the main list is the selling price on each card (services, and inventory items in categories mapped to the hospital); every other list has one currency, a frozen rate, a discount rule (services / medicines / consumables), a validity and versions, with lines reviewed before approval. Bills keep their list, currency and closing rate; payments keep the facility-currency amount. Four new tables plus nullable columns on HospitalPatients, HospitalBills, HospitalBillLines, HospitalPayments and HospitalBillingSettings; idempotent, proven twice-run.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-02 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H8: the laboratory — lab-test setup (specimen, section) and analytes (unit, reference and critical limits) for Lab-category services; lab orders born one-to-one from a signed visit's lab order lines, walking Ordered, Collected, Received, Resulted, Verified; and results as snapshots of their analyte. Two-step: a technician enters, a different specialist verifies; a value past a critical limit flags the order until the call to the doctor is recorded. Critical values are told through alerts on any screen of the system, acknowledged by reading the value back, reminded and escalated within the department. Five new tables; idempotent, proven twice-run.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-02 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H9: radiology — imaging-exam setup (modality, contrast, report template) for Radiology-category services; imaging rooms (machines) with a modality and a maintenance switch; imaging orders born one-to-one from a signed visit's radiology order lines, walking Scheduled, Arrived, Scanning, Reporting, Signed, with the radiologist's report. The H8 critical-value alerts now name a lab order or an imaging order (exactly one). Three new tables plus a nullable column and a check on HospitalLabCriticalAlerts; idempotent, proven twice-run.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-02 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H10: the pharmacy, dispensing from the inventory — the pharmacy store setting; dispenses born one-to-one from a signed visit's prescription (New, Verified, Dispensed) with their lines naming an inventory item or a drug not stocked; stock leaves through the inventory's own movements (nearest expiry first) and each dispensed line keeps its batches and the bill line it was charged on. A prescription line may name its item; a bill line may come from the pharmacy. Three new tables plus a nullable column on HospitalPrescriptionLines and a widened check on HospitalBillLines; idempotent, proven twice-run.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-03 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H11: insurance and claims — six new tables (HospitalPayers, HospitalPatientPolicies, HospitalPreauths, HospitalClaimBatches, HospitalClaims, HospitalClaimLines) with their CHECK constraints and foreign keys to the H2/H6/H7 tables, and eight unique guards of which three are filtered. It alters, drops and writes nothing existing, and refuses to start unless the H2/H6/H7 tables exist — six creation guards plus a prerequisite check (THROW 51990). Applied to CrossBuyDB2 on 2026-11-03 and re-run with no change, the object snapshots before and after compared by SHA-256; the file that ran is sha256 8ce88481b2bf1dd406a41acaf127925a74dee76a4f9c933b15153c87896b4afb, 12296 bytes.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-03 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H12: estimates and packages — three new tables with their CHECK constraints and foreign keys, and two unique guards, neither filtered. HospitalPackages holds fixed-price procedure packages (main service, included nights, room class, what they cover); HospitalEstimates holds a planned admission's priced estimate for one patient, split between payer and patient by the patient's cover, with the deposit to ask and the approval request issuing it filed; and HospitalEstimateLines holds that estimate's frozen lines (package, extra nights, services) with each line's payer share. It alters, drops and writes nothing existing, and refuses to start unless the H1/H2/H6/H11 tables exist — three creation guards plus a prerequisite check (THROW 51990). Applied to CrossBuyDB2 on 2026-11-03 and re-run with no change, the object snapshots before and after compared by SHA-256; the file that ran is sha256 1f21016503e8c74353b6693ad03d204646c6a7c3c445d3945eae8daf54a6275b, 7195 bytes.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-03 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H13: the emergency department — two new tables, which the file itself calls 'the bays and the visits': HospitalErBays and HospitalErVisits. Four unique guards, of which TWO are filtered — one stops a bay holding two open visits, the other stops a patient holding two. It alters, drops and writes nothing existing, and refuses to start unless the H2 and H4 tables exist — two creation guards plus a prerequisite check (THROW 51990) naming hospital_h2_patients.sql and hospital_h4_outpatient.sql; it does NOT depend on H11 or H12. Applied to CrossBuyDB2 on 2026-11-03 and re-run with no change, the object snapshots before and after compared by SHA-256; the file that ran is sha256 78691d01579a27f34561ec537154bc73cd4dacfafa545edcc8c43582505255f1, 5975 bytes.

slices.appliedStatus: APPLIED to CrossBuyDB2 2026-11-03 (objects verified by catalogue; not in PlatformSchemaHistory)
slices.note: Hospital H14: medication orders and nursing — four new tables with their CHECK constraints and foreign keys, and two unique guards of which one is filtered. HospitalMedOrders holds the doctor's medication orders for an admitted patient (drug, optional inventory item, dose, route, the ward-clock hours or "as needed", controlled or not, active or stopped); HospitalMarEntries is the medication administration record, one answer per scheduled dose (given, held or missed, with the reason when not given and, for a controlled drug, a witness who is not the recording nurse; a filtered unique index lets only one answer land); HospitalNursingTasks is the ward's per-patient to-do list with due and done times; and HospitalShiftHandovers keeps one handover note per ward, day and shift. It alters, drops and writes nothing existing, and refuses to start unless the H1/H2/H3 tables exist — four creation guards plus a prerequisite check (THROW 51990) naming hospital_h1_facility.sql, hospital_h2_patients.sql and hospital_h3_admissions.sql; it does NOT depend on H11-H13. Applied to CrossBuyDB2 on 2026-11-03 and re-run with no change, the object snapshots before and after compared by SHA-256; the file that ran is sha256 365d66149a6a9ca66b8a688563e3ecd7114ea37f9bff59fee0f6e3ceeb99367a, 6760 bytes.
